figurative_meaning_en: Similar to passing time or consuming time unnecessarily
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই গল্পে অপ্রয়োজনীয় বিবরণ দিয়ে কালহরণ করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The story engages in time-wasting with unnecessary details.
I was killing time by reading the book.
history: Referenced in the works of Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay, where it is used to describe avoiding lengthy descriptions that consume the reader's time.
note: Primarily used in literary contexts to denote prolonging or consuming time in narration.
